starting_state: A committed plan item is enabled, its exact authority request has been decided, and its executor, provider, environment, sandbox, limits, and criteria are bound.
preconditions: an allow decision for the exact action and resources
enforceable sandbox, network, tool, secret, timeout, retention, and cost limits.
intention: Perform human, command, projection, transition, or agent work only within the exact granted boundary and retain evidence for later settlement.
job: Authorize first, execute under declared isolation and environment constraints, observe bounded progress, and hand outcomes to evaluation without equating termination with success.
authority_requirements: Attributable actor context and role resolution
Policy digest binding against active snapshot
expected_consequential_state_transitions: Enabled work becomes denied, escalated, running, terminated, timed out, cancelled, violated, or disconnected
execution results and evidence become settlement inputs but never settlement themselves.
settlement_condition: Execution terminates within the granted boundary and leaves complete outcome evidence for settlement, including governed denial or failure; only settlement may accept the work.
expected_next_decisions_and_affordances: change provider or environment through a new authorized attempt
applicable_failure_and_recovery_behavior: Deny before effects when authority fails
retain evidence for timeout, sandbox violation, cancellation, endpoint failure, and disconnect
create a successor attempt rather than overwrite a run
repair provider or boundary configuration before retry.
expected_unavailable_states: external un-sandboxed host execution without grant is forbidden
